title: Introduce conversation and platform message history domain boundary
description: AstrBot separates conversation management and platform message history from raw database helpers. Rust currently has session context ports, WebChat in-memory history, and planned storage ports, but no conversation-domain manager for current conversation, message pairs, persona links, and platform history readback. Define this before persistent memory parity grows inside WebChat or pipeline context.

files.change: Own current conversation, switch/delete/update flows separately from storage implementation.
Expose platform message history read/write policy outside WebChat transport.
Keep persona selection metadata out of generic storage repositories.

criteria: Pipeline continues to depend on session context traits, not concrete conversation storage.
WebChat history routes delegate to a history service boundary.
Storage repositories remain implementation details behind conversation-domain ports.
